difficulty: Legendary Stalker (default); difficulty does not alter trophies

build.early_weapon: Path of the Bastard (Technique) or Wintry Rapier (Technique): choose either as the Technique-lane starting weapon
build.weapon_sequence: Path of the Bastard or Wintry Rapier start; Booster Glaive handle Chapter 3; Bone-Cutting Sawblade becomes available only after acquiring it in Chapter 5 Malum District; then assemble Sawblade + Booster Glaive
build.optional_pivot: Trident of the Covenant, then Proof of Humanity when obtained
principles: Guard, perfect guard, stagger, fatal attack
build.stats: Raise Vitality and Vigor to comfortable survival, Capacity for weight/defense, and Technique for the chosen handle; do not spend in Motivity unless deliberately testing a Motivity handle.
p_organ: Prioritize guard regain, stagger window, pulse-cell capacity, healing efficiency, and perfect-guard utility; unlock quartz slots by completing chapter objectives.
build.legion: Falcon Eyes for ranged punish windows or Aegis for safe guard practice; refill at Stargazers and do not make boss plans depend on Legion consumables.
build.defense: Use the highest physical-defense frame/liner/sleeve that stays under the desired weight tier; match elemental resistance when known. Exact absorption values are intentionally unknown unless sourced.

patch_delta.summary: Fixes the achievement/trophy issue where Extreme Potential could fail to unlock after P-Organ Recalibration; no combat-balance claim is made.

enemy_classes.plan: Use electric weapon/abrasive when available; guard and punish recoveries.
Fire abrasive or flame weapon; avoid assuming every variant shares the same resistance.
Learn weapon timing, perfect guard, and fatal-attack openings.
Guard/parry; use stagger and back attacks rather than throwables.
Keep distance from grabs and use charged heavies after whiffs.
Do not apply the generic puppet rule: use acid for damage and avoid electric blitz. Physical weapon, guard, perfect guard, and burst punish remain reliable non-consumable options.

bosses.name: Parade Master
bosses.plan: Stay close to side/rear, guard the club sequence, punish after recovery.

bosses.name: Scrapped Watchman
bosses.plan: Exception to simple puppet taxonomy; learn delayed lightning and punish after combos.

bosses.name: Survivor
bosses.plan: Circle and backstab; avoid greed.

bosses.name: Fuoco, King's Flame
bosses.plan: Physical guard and fire resistance; punish vent/recovery.

bosses.name: Archbishop Andreus
bosses.plan: Guard front attacks, rotate for rear phase, use fire if confirmed.

bosses.name: Black Rabbit Brotherhood
bosses.plan: Control adds, isolate target, punish long recoveries.

bosses.name: King of Puppets / Romeo
bosses.plan: Guard first phase; learn Romeo's fast strings and phase transition.

bosses.name: Champion Victor
bosses.plan: Keep midrange, perfect guard rushes, punish whiffs.

bosses.name: Green Monster of the Swamp
bosses.plan: Fire where confirmed; watch burrow/grab and delay attacks.

bosses.name: Laxasia the Complete
bosses.plan: Perfect guard lightning and rushes; survive phase transition before damage greed.

bosses.name: Simon Manus, Arm of God
bosses.plan: Stay mobile, guard delayed holy attacks, punish end-lag.

bosses.name: Nameless Puppet
bosses.plan: Optional ending boss; perfect guard, guard regain, and disciplined healing.

bosses.name: Tyrannical Predator
bosses.plan: Keep moving around the arena, guard the lunges, and punish recovery without consumables.

bosses.name: Markiona
bosses.plan: Maintain midrange, guard the strings, and punish confirmed recovery with physical damage.

bosses.name: Veronique
bosses.plan: Read delayed attacks, perfect-guard the committed strings, and use fatal attacks after stagger.

bosses.name: Two-faced Overseer
bosses.plan: Stay at safe midrange, guard the paired patterns, and punish the recovery window.

bosses.name: Premetamorphic Green Hunter
bosses.plan: Avoid burrow/grab lanes, guard the rush, and punish the end of its combo physically.

bosses.name: Anguished Guardian
bosses.plan: Hold position outside the grab, perfect-guard committed attacks, and take safe stagger punishments.

bosses.name: Lumacchio
bosses.plan: Use patient guard and spacing, then punish recovery; do not rely on throwables.

bosses.name: Arlecchino
bosses.plan: Control spacing, perfect-guard the strings, and finish with physical stagger and fatal attacks.

farms.method: clear repeatable puppets, reset at Stargazer; no throwables required

farms.stage: Malum District Red Lobster Inn route
farms.method: short loop to Stargazer; use guard and fatal attacks
clear dense humanoid/puppet packs safely; reset frequently
No verified deterministic DLC farm loop is established in the cited sources; use the verified Arche Abbey outer/inner loops for repeatable base-game ergo/materials instead.
